note: Lawrence County, OH (39087) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county does not zone unincorporated land beyond subdivision rules (SWCD planning commission page). Ironton's official zoning map is kept on file per Codified Ordinance 1256.02 with no digital service link; the city's page links no GIS viewer. ArcGIS search for Lawrence County zoning returned only unrelated layers, and the one generic Zoning_Districts service found covers no part of the county (0 features in the county's bounding box). Other municipalities' maps are only third-party aggregator listings.
